test_moolib_rpc_pickle: test that moolib.Rpc correctly pickles complex objects across host and client connections
test_rpc_define_and_sync: test defining an RPC method on the host and calling it synchronously from the client
test_rpc_host_listen: test creating an moolib.Rpc host that listens on a given address for incoming connections
test_rpc_client_connect: test creating an moolib.Rpc client that connects to a host and sends pickled messages
test_slots_class_serialization: test that classes using __slots__ serialize correctly over moolib RPC connections
